jdns.description: Top-level configuration for jdns invocation parameters.

jdns.query_type.description: The DNS record type to query (e.g., a, ptr, srv).

jdns.query_name.description: The domain name or host to query.

jdns.nameservers.description: List of nameserver addresses in 'host' or 'host;port' format. Required for 'uni' mode if not using system defaults.

jdns.quiet_timeout.description: Quit after x seconds (-q x flag). Set to 0 to disable.
